svg.title: STRIDE, the back of the card
svg.desc: Can evolution alone teach a jointed figure to walk? A 2D stick figure with six motorised joints (hips, knees, shoulders) and two spring elbows in a pymunk physics world. Each joint follows a sine wave with three genes, amplitude, frequency and phase, so a walker is eighteen numbers. A genetic algorithm breeds, mutates and selects 100 walkers over 75 generations; fitness is distance minus falls and wasted energy. Particle swarm, differential evolution and CMA-ES across seventeen experiments, with a React and Three.js dashboard where the walkers can be watched and their genes edited. Live at stridewalk.fun. February to March 2026, ten commits.
